_doc: A SHAPE TO COPY, NOT A SIGNATURE. Every provenance field below is blank, so tests/helpers/goldenRecordDoor.js REFUSES this file — and tests/lint/goldenFreeze.walker.test.js asserts that refusal on every gate run, so the template can never quietly become an authorization. Copy it, fill it, name it for its cause and date, and never edit a record after the fact: the register pins each one by hash, and a record that needs correcting is superseded by a new record that says so.
